# Regression: a translatable string passed a reactive prop, under an explicit
# i18n.locale() block, must render on initial load. The init write used to go
# through the standalone TranslateIRExpr path, which left i18n intrinsics as a
# raw, undefined `intl.Translate(...)` and read the synthesized locale context
# var off `state.` — so __sngl_init() threw and the text was blank until a
# button handler (translated via the correct path) re-rendered it.

sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=out app.sngl
exists out/index.html

# The init must call the real i18n runtime, never a raw undefined intrinsic...
grep 'function __sngl_init' out/index.html
! grep 'intl\.Translate' out/index.html
! grep 'intl\.NumberInt' out/index.html
# ...and must not state-prefix the synthesized locale context var (undefined at runtime).
! grep 'state\.__ctx_locale' out/index.html

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"
import "sngl://i18n"

component Cart(count = 0) {
    text(value=$"Cart: {count, plural, =0{empty} one{1 item} other{# items}}")
}
component main {
    var count = 3
    vbox {
        i18n.locale("es-MX") {
            Cart(count=count)
        }
        button(text="+", @click { count += 1 })
    }
}
